report: Reviewed the complete current claim, both associated TODO tests, all three implementation entries and both complete implementation files. Verified exact byte matches against the historical input for both implementation_sources and both test_sources, and the claim is unchanged. This supports the historical rationale but is not a new behavioral run. Requirement assessment: run_fixture is ordinary evidence in both oracle_compare and independent_coverage targets; before comparison it independently checks oracle and sage outputs for DbDropGuard::db (body, call target, receiver borrow/field/dereference), Parse::next (body, dispatch, substitutions and mutable receiver, plus placeholder filtering), and external_adt_default (nominal IntoIter with materialized allocator). Snapshot comparisons are also performed separately for the first two fixtures. These visible checks establish limited per-fixture guards, not exhaustive source inventories or universal rejection. Other fixtures lack a generic inventory/placeholder guard, and the annotation branch returns through annotation checking; neither establishes the universal claim here. The TODO implementation explicitly accounts for the missing independent per-emitter item/body inventories and shared forbidden-placeholder validator. Both are prerequisites to accepting equality only after every in-scope item/body is accounted for and rejecting paired omissions, unsupported nodes and debug fallbacks even when bytes agree. The service_spec TODO defers the complete adversarial removal/replacement matrix across items, associated and generated/source-written bodies, expression families and type families on each side. The independent_coverage TODO additionally requires enabling the preserved unsupported-body regression, adding omitted-item/body and debug-fallback cases, and independently rejecting each emitter before comparison. Both empty TODO bodies are deferral documentation, not executed behavioral coverage. The ignored, unassociated regression visibly asserts that run_fixture rejects a generated conditional-body fixture; its ignored status preserves the known gap without claiming eligible coverage. The supplied historical report records its earlier failure and subsequent TODO-only passing run; I did not rerun or independently reproduce those commands. No additional implementation behavior is inferred from emitters or helper dependencies beyond the supplied harness source. The current explicit deferrals adequately retain all missing universal behavior and testing prerequisites, so no accounting edits are needed; the anchor remains deferred, not implemented. Execution in this review was review start/read, source inspection and exact baseline comparison, followed by review record; no source edits or behavioral tests. The coordinator-reported 321-test suite and root build are separate baseline execution, not mine.
